sn45.69:1.1: la || || -yad idaṃ yonisomanasikārasampadā || || Yonisomanasikārasampannassetam bhikkhave bhikkhun opātikaṅkham ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvessati a- a- maggam bahulīkarissati || || Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bahulīkaroti Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti || pe || sammāsamadhim bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkarotī ti || ||
